pr.title: feat(app): `basePath` option for the constructor, deprecate `app.basePath()`

summary: This PR adds a `basePath` constructor option to Hono and deprecates the `app.basePath()` method. The changes refactor the internal `_basePath` field to use private field syntax (`#basePath`) and introduce a new `HonoOptions` type. The implementation appears functionally correct with comprehensive test coverage for the new feature.
